lines: Jacobs has played 3 of GB's 10 games. In those, he played 46% of snaps, with 12.0 carries and 4.3 targets per game.
He averaged 14.6 PPR points per game, with 5.7 red zone carries plus targets per game and 3 total TDs on the season.
GB has a bye in Wk 11. The coach said Jacobs will have surgery the day after the Nov. 12 press conference, and his long-term status will be known afterward.
